templates.title: SiteWatcher
templates.description: Self-hosted website monitoring for uptime, response times, TLS and domain expiry, with shareable status pages. Source: https://github.com/NikKurkov/sitewatcher

env.name: SITEWATCHER_PORT
env.label: Local HTTP port
env.description: The port on the Docker host. Use an SSH tunnel if Portainer is on a remote server.

templates.note: In the web container's console, run sitewatcher setup once to create the owner. Then sign in at http://127.0.0.1:18080 on the Docker host, or forward the port over SSH. The web service and worker share a named volume at /data.
